text.card: A red giant 1,851 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.99 solar masses and 9.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,570 K at its surface.
